Upper Text: DigiXros -1: ∞ Digimon cards w/[Xros Heart] or [Blue Flare] trait & different card numbers

When you would play this card from your hand, by placing 1 [Shoutmon] as a digivolution card of this Digimon, reduce the play cost by 1 and you may place cards in your trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
[On Play] Return all of the digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck in any order, and return that Digimon to the bottom of its owner's deck.
[Your Turn] All of your opponent's [Security] effects on Option cards don't activate.
